description: Store graph snapshots across runs in a local SQLite store so agents can diff before-domain vs. after-domain state and measure drift over time; no external resource dependency.

requirements.description: Cartographer must store graph snapshots across runs in a local SQLite store (AC-SNAPSHOT-STORE) with no external resource dependency. Agents must be able to diff before-domain vs. after-domain state across runs (AC-SNAPSHOT-DIFF). Per-domain drift measurement over time must be computable from stored snapshots (AC-SNAPSHOT-DRIFT). Snapshots are keyed by scenario, run timestamp, and content hash.
requirements.title: Snapshot Persistence — SQLite Graph Store with Diffing and Drift Measurement

validation.notes: AC-SNAPSHOT-STORE: Graph snapshot serializes to and deserializes from SQLite without data loss
AC-SNAPSHOT-STORE: Snapshots are keyed by (scenario_id, timestamp, content_hash) with a unique constraint
AC-SNAPSHOT-DIFF: Diff between two snapshots correctly identifies added nodes, removed nodes, added edges, and removed edges
AC-SNAPSHOT-DRIFT: Drift metric (conflict count delta) between two snapshots is correctly computed per domain
Run extraction twice against the same fixture; second run's snapshot matches first run's snapshot (determinism)
Modify a fixture file, run extraction, and diff shows exactly the modified file's node as changed
arch-cart drift --domain <name> shows the conflict count change over the last N runs using stored snapshots
A team can track architecture improvement over time by comparing snapshot drift metrics before and after migration sprints
No external database or network connection is required to store or query snapshots

title: Snapshot Persistence
